title: AtlasMind Lens live service endpoints
description: The databases and APIs a lens may reach to compare a declared schema against the one actually served. This file is committed: it names a stored secret with `secretRef` and must never contain a token, password, or connection string. AtlasMind reads shape only — the catalog, never a row — and never writes.

label.description: Shown on every surface, and the exact text you must type to confirm a probe of a production endpoint.

kind.description: `http-openapi`: the URL points at the schema document, not the API root. `graphql`: the introspection endpoint. `postgres`/`mysql`: a direct connection using the connection string stored under `secretRef`. `sql-http`: a vendor SQL-over-HTTPS API (`vendor` required). `database`: reached through a connected MCP server instead of directly.

stage.description: An endpoint that does not state its stage is treated as production, and asks you to type its label before every probe.

url.description: Absolute https URL, for `http-openapi`, `graphql` and `sql-http`. Plaintext http is accepted only on the loopback, because a probe may carry a bearer token. Credentials embedded in the URL are refused. Omit entirely for `postgres`, `mysql` and `database` — the host lives in the stored connection string, not in this file.

vendor.description: Required for `sql-http`. Each vendor's HTTP SQL API uses a different envelope, so AtlasMind will not guess which one a URL speaks.

mcpServerId.description: Required for `database`. The connected MCP server whose schema-reading tool should be asked. A server exposing only a generic query tool is not used: AtlasMind will not hand SQL to a third-party tool.

secretRef.description: The name of a key in VS Code SecretStorage — never a value. Holds a bearer token for an HTTP endpoint, or the whole connection string for `postgres`/`mysql`/`sql-http`, where it is required. Store it with `AtlasMind: Store a Live Service Credential`. The name is namespaced before it reaches SecretStorage, so it cannot read a key belonging to anything else. A document containing an actual credential is refused whole.

expectedContractIds.description: Repository contract ids this endpoint is expected to serve. An id that no longer resolves is reported as a dead end rather than dropped.
